name: Drums
description: Tempo-synced multi-genre drum kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. GENRE selects Trance / DnB / Breakbeat / UK Garage / Boom-bap / Dembow / Footwork patterns. X densifies ghosts/hats/stutters; Y pushes fill energy. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Trap808 stays a separate specialised unit.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Genre density: hats, ghosts, rims, or kick stutters

params.name: FILL
params.detail: Fill / break / build energy toward a one-bar Fill

params.name: GENRE
params.detail: TRNC / DNB / BRK / UKG / BOOM / DEM / FOOT
